videos.title: Hometown With Rachel Nichols
videos.description: The Washington Wizards had a massive, pivotal offseason, and Rachel was on the inside with all the key decision-makers. Now, as a new season gets underway, she drops in on Wizards Media Day, gets to know rookie sensation AJ Dybantsa, and sits down with players to talk about the chemistry that's beginning to take shape.
